basic_details.short_information: The Wellness Centre of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee needs 2 Project Officers (Clinical Psychologist) for the project "Clinical Psychologist at Wellness Centre", funded from Internal Resources, IIT Roorkee, initially for 1 year and extendable on performance up to 5 years. The pay is Rs. 65,000/- to Rs. 75,000/- + HRA, depending upon experience. Candidates need an M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology or equivalent with at least 55% marks and valid CRR, plus 2 years of relevant experience. Applications go by email to [email protected] by 5 PM on 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Project Officer (Clinical Psychologist) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention an application fee.

rows.details: Initially for 1 year, extended based on performance up to 5 years
Rs. 65,000/- to Rs. 75,000/- + HRA, depending upon experience

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology or equivalent with at least 55% marks from a university/institute recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India with valid CRR. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience after the qualifying degree (M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology). The notice defines relevant experience as: Clinical experience of group counselling as well as individual counselling in an educational institution or in a reputed mental health care clinic. Experience in handling psychiatric emergencies. Experience in Biofeedback/Neurofeedback with youth population. Candidates with demonstrated professional experience in de-addiction services, marital and family counselling, queer-affirmative mental health practice, behavioral addiction management, and trauma-focused psychotherapy will be preferred. Fellowship in Mental Health relevant areas from a reputed institution. PhD in Clinical Psychology. The age limit is 45 years (including age relaxation). The notice does not print a separate cut-off date for counting age. Only Indian nationals may apply. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs. 65,000/- to Rs. 75,000/- + HRA, depending upon experience, so HRA is paid in addition to the stated amount and the exact figure within the range depends on the candidate's experience. The notice does not state the HRA rate. The appointment is initially for 1 year and may be extended based on performance up to 5 years.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Project Officer (Clinical Psychologist) Job Description
content_sections.text: Annexure "B" of the notice lists the duties and responsibilities for counsellors: Provide individual and group counselling/therapy sessions to students and staff seeking psychological support. Conduct psychological assessments using appropriate standardised tools and provide interventions or referrals based on the assessment. Maintain accurate and confidential documentation of counselling sessions, assessments, interventions, and follow-ups, and undertake appropriate analysis of counselling data for monitoring and service improvement. Work six days a week as per the schedule prescribed by the Wellness Centre. Remain available on campus for emergency psychological support, as and when required. Provide biofeedback-based interventions, wherever appropriate, and maintain the associated documentation and records. Participate in Wellness Centre programmes, workshops, awareness activities, and other mental-health initiatives as required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Project Officer (Clinical Psychologist)
content_sections.text: Applications are submitted by email to the office of ADoSW(SW) at [email protected] . The last date is 30 November 2026, by 5 PM. The notice does not specify an email subject line. Documents named in the notice: Application on plain paper with a detailed CV, including the chronological discipline of degrees/certificates obtained. Details of experience, including research, administration and others. A merged PDF of attested copies of all relevant degree/certificate and experience certificates, in descending order. Candidates must make sure they are eligible for the position before appearing for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be verified, and only shortlisted candidates will be informed for the interview through email after the verification of documents. The notice does not give an interview date or venue. Candidates must bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) that were attached to the email at the time of the interview for verification. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.
